log_dir.description: Directory where session log files are written. May include strftime patterns like %Y-%m-%d for per-day logs.

log_format.description: Format string for each log entry. Placeholders: {user}, {resource}, {ip}, {timestamp}, {action}.

max_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) per log file. Set to 0 to disable rotation.

max_files.description: Number of rotated log files to retain (ignored if max_size = 0).

log_open.description: Log when a client opens a new session (connects).

log_close.description: Log when a client closes its session (disconnects).

log_auth.description: Log when a user successfully authenticates (note: may expose sensitive info).

log_hosts.description: List of XMPP hosts (domains) to log sessions for. If empty, log sessions for all configured hosts.
